title: compact policy bundler, staged apply plan, and safe rollback hooks for private installer
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Private deployments have been impacted by slow policy bundle applies and fragile rollbacks during multi-tenant upgrades. This PR introduces a compact policy bundler to dedupe and canonicalize tenant policy templates, a staged apply flow that splits Terraform/Helm applies into dry-run, validate, and staged-commit phases, and a safe-rollback hookset that can revert only stage-scoped resources to minimize blast radius. The changeset touches the installer controller, Helm preflight checks, Terraform module wrappers, and the policy bundle generation pipeline. Key goals: reduce bundle payload size, make policy apply idempotent across retries, provide deterministic rollbacks that avoid tenant-wide role deletions, and add drift-detection guardrails to prevent partial state from being promoted. This description summarizes design, implementation notes, and operational runbook changes in a single continuous string as required.
commits: feat(bundle): implement compact bundler that canonicalizes policy templates and produces reference dedupe map
chore(terraform): introduce staged-apply wrapper that runs plan->validate->apply with stage markers
feat(helm): add preflight rbac checks and dry-run validator for chart upgrades
fix(rbac): make tenant role creation idempotent by guarding with annotation match and resource-hashes
feat(rollback): add safe-taint rollback hookset and e2e test scaffold
test(e2e): add staged-apply smoke tests and drift-detection scenario
review_comments: Diego Morales commented: Can you walk through the dedupe map format? We need to ensure it remains stable across bundle generations to avoid unnecessary churn. Also please add a compact-bundle version marker so old installers can still consume full bundles.

Author (Aisha Patel) replied: The dedupe map is a deterministic map keyed by the SHA256 of sorted template+params; added a version field in compact.go and a compatibility shim in the bundler README to maintain backward compatibility.
Claire Huang requested changes: The staged-apply wrapper looks good but add a timeout and retry policy for the validate stage and surface metrics for each stage in the console.

Author (Aisha Patel) addressed: Added stage_timeout config, exponential retry for transient plan errors, and emitted 'policy.apply.stage.duration' and 'policy.apply.stage.status' metrics in observability.

Samir Rao approved with comment: Verified e2e smoke test locally against minikube. Rollback hooks restored only stage resources in my run. Recommend we document the manual rollback steps in runbook before merge.
ci_checks: integration: fail transient - helm template flake; retriggered
merge_outcome: merged via squash by Claire Huang after CI green and approvals; merge commit message prefixed with 'installer: compact policy bundler & staged apply'.
release_notes: - Add compact policy bundler to reduce policy bundle size and deduplicate templates. - Staged apply flow for Terraform/Helm: dry-run, validate, staged-commit to reduce failed-upgrade blast radius. - Safe rollback hooks (taint-based) to revert only stage-scoped resources. - Helm preflight RBAC checks and dry-run validator. - Observability: per-stage metrics for policy apply. See ops/runbooks/private-installer-rollback.md for rollback procedures.
